title: Beyond Aesthetics: Cultural Competence in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluates cultural competence along two dimensions: 'cultural awareness' (measured via human annotations of cultural relevance, faithfulness, and realism on images generated from specific cultural artifact prompts) and 'cultural diversity' (measured using a quality-weighted Vendi score to assess the geo-cultural variety of artifacts generated from under-specified prompts, mapped using VLM and LLM pipelines).
